reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 5 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Trail Blazers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 62 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 203 and 251 total points.
